title: Black Hole Recordings unveils 'Hypnotised presents Anthem Trance'
excerpt: Hypnotised presents Anthem Trance, compiled by Arjan Rietveld, gathers 27 trance anthems from Tiësto, Armin van Buuren and more on Dec 4.
content:
Black Hole Recordings takes on trance’s anthems with ‘Hypnotised presents Anthem Trance’

19 November 2026

2 minutes · By Staff

What turns a dancefloor weapon into an undisputed anthem? That is the question behind the next chapter of Black Hole Recordings' Hypnotised series. Hypnotised presents Anthem Trance arrives on December 4, and pre-orders are open now.

As with the rest of the series, the compilation is curated by Arjan Rietveld, the author of the book Hypnotised – A Journey Through Trance. This time he takes on what the label calls trance’s most contested term, the anthem, a word that gets attached to countless big records but means something different to every generation of trance fans.

Across 27 tracks, the collection moves from the classics of the 1990s, through the club-defining moments of the 2000s and into the mainstage anthems of a newer generation. The artist list reads like a history of the genre, with music from Tiësto, Armin van Buuren, Ferry Corsten and BT next to Johan Gielen, Matt Darey and Giuseppe Ottaviani. Signum, Ralphie B, Lost Witness and Robert Nickson are also part of the selection, among many more.

The release continues a busy run for the series. Black Hole Recordings recently released Hypnotised presents Progressive Trance, and earlier this year Hypnotised presents Balearic Trance rounded up classics from the White Isle. With Anthem Trance, the series moves from a sound or a place to the records that crowds have claimed as their own, spanning three decades of the genre in a single collection.

Hypnotised presents Anthem Trance lands on December 4 via Black Hole Recordings and can be pre-ordered now.
